resources.string: Save any WhatsApp status in one tap
First, grant 4 permissions. Then the floating SAVE button is yours — and it only appears while you are watching a status.
Lets the small SAVE button hover over WhatsApp while you view statuses.
Lets the app read WhatsApp\'s hidden status folder so it can save what you viewed. Nothing else is touched.
Android 13+ needs this so the floating button can stay alive in the background.

Lets the button appear ONLY while a WhatsApp status is playing, and stay hidden everywhere else. StatusSaver watches which screen is open — it cannot read your messages or anything on screen. In Settings, open Accessibility → Installed apps → StatusSaver and turn it on.
Shows the StatusSaver download button only while you are viewing a WhatsApp status, and hides it on every other screen. It detects which app window is open only — it does not read screen content.
